content: If you want to completely isolate the networking stack of a container, you can use the --network none flag when starting the container. Within the container, only the loopback device is created. No IPv6 loopback address is configured for containers using the none driver.
conclusion: The `--network none` flag completely isolates the container's networking stack, creating only an IPv4 loopback device (no IPv6 loopback address is configured).
